name: North Hamgyong (South Korea, nominal province)
description: A maroon field bearing a roundel of mountains within a floral wreath above 咸鏡北道 in white.
history: One of the five provinces of North Korea claimed by the Republic of Korea and represented by its Committee for the Five Northern Korean Provinces; the flag is that committee's design and is not used in the territory.

features.role: emblem: mountains within a wreath of flowers
